Subject: SOC 2 / DPA walkthrough — proposed 90m slot + optional dry-run

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the team at FinEdge would like to schedule the more formal SOC 2 + DPA walkthrough you mentioned to close our security intake. We expect participants from InfoSec, AppSec, and Procurement (~6 people).

Could you propose 2x 90-minute windows over the next week? We prefer US business hours (PDT) but can do an evening slot if it helps. Also, we'd like to request a short 15-minute preflight/dry-run the day before the main walkthrough to test evidence handoff and the shared drive access.

Attached is a rough evidence manifest to help you prep.

Thanks,
Alex Patterson
Head of IT Ops, FinEdge
apatterson@finedge.com

Attachment: finedge_evidence_manifest_v1.xlsx

From: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / DPA walkthrough — proposed 90m slot + optional dry-run

Hi Alex — thanks for the manifest, that helps. Happy to run the walkthrough + DPA review. Quick thoughts:

- We typically run a 60-minute technical walkthrough (architecture, data flows, access controls) followed by a 30-minute controls/Q&A and evidence review.
- A 15-minute preflight the day before is a great idea to validate Drive permissions and service account access.
- We have these open windows (PDT):
  • Mon 19 Jul 10:00–11:30
  • Tue 20 Jul 16:00–17:30 (we can extend to 18:00 if needed)
  • Wed 21 Jul 18:30–20:00 (evening option)

If none of those work, tell me your top two preferences and I’ll coordinate. For the preflight we usually book a 15-minute slot 24 hours prior (same host list).

I’ve attached our preflight checklist so your ops folks know what we’ll try to validate.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
avery@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood_preflight-checklist.pdf
